_comment: Declarative policy for the Wizard's shipped userdata pack. Bump config_version whenever any file changes. Fresh installs seed build defaults; existing devices retain their chosen values. Modes: replace, merge_id (build wins), merge_missing_id (add only missing setting IDs), merge_name (add missing sources), seed_if_absent.

files._note: Kodi writes guisettings.xml from memory on a normal shutdown. A live update merge is discarded then, while a fresh install uses the Wizard's existing hard-close path. Preserve the entire running user's GUI file on update until an explicit live Settings API migration is implemented.
Fresh installs receive the build's POV defaults. Updates only add missing setting IDs and preserve existing metadata, provider and account choices; credential IDs are excluded even when missing.
Keep existing favourites on update; the orderfavourites generator three-way merges changed defaults against its last baseline. Kodi users can reorder, edit, remove and add these shortcuts.
Keep a device's cache/network/memory choices on update; seed the build defaults only when no user file exists.
Seed new installations; preserve a returning user's menu order and hidden/custom entries. Runtime visibility patches supply new conditional service rows without rewriting this database.
Preserve a returning user's per-list view choices.
Seed new installations; preserve a returning user's custom FENtastic home and widget paths.

cleanup._comment: Do not delete legacy user addon_data during a modular upgrade.
